reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: I tried this app years ago and it seems like all the money they have earned they just spend on advertising and certainly not improving their app. The issues I had with it before are all still here. I won’t waste time or money with this again.

reviews.title: My take on Run Across America App
reviews.text: Easy to use, easy to connect to Strava. Love the import multiple activities functionality and it’s for a great cause.

reviews.title: Just do it!
reviews.text: This is an effective app for staying motivating and participating solo (or in groups/teams) in daily physical activities

reviews.title: Using this app since their inception!
reviews.text: I LOVE this app! Each season, there are challenges to complete- including running, walking, swimming, biking, dog walking, etc. It does not matter how fast you are, the app set-up strives to keep you moving. This program has kept me active for many years now!!

reviews.title: Motivation
reviews.text: This program keeps me motivated to walk every day at least 1km but almost always farther. Sometimes much farther.

reviews.title: I love run across America
reviews.text: This is the best workout app I’ve ever used and it shows other people to and it help me keep track of my workouts and you can make teams and join other teams but you got to be invited -Ariana walker

reviews.title: Not the best, not the worst
reviews.text:
I used this app & virtual run program for two seasons now - Spring and Fall. The apps fairly easy to use. I appreciate the option to include other physical activities like strength training into the count. 
I give an average review because 2x I’ve had mishaps with my registration. First time they sent me the wrong item, and second time I didn’t receive my medal.

reviews.title: Great fun, one small critique
reviews.text: First, let me preface this with the fact that this is only my second virtual race- perhaps this is normal and I should just get used to it. Plus I would like to say I am enjoying how it's motivating me to get out there, and that you have a walking option. I have only one criticism. I signed up for the Fall Frenzy run- though I will be hiking not running. I like the fall season and feel of the race. But I live in southern Arizona, where it is just now in October starting to get cool in the mornings. I managed to get my first hike in early September when there was some surprise good weather, and was really excited to record my first entry. Now how do you think I felt when I looked at my first finish, and the feedback I got was not "good job!" or "nice start," but instead a criticism that I was already running behind schedule. ?????? I was not aware that I was under any schedule other than my own. All the excitement I had evaporated in that moment. I even thought about not bothering with the race anymore at all. I'm glad I stayed with it. I suppose that "motivation" works for some people, but it was disheartening to me.

reviews.title: Can’t even use the app
reviews.text: You have to sign up on a separate website and then pay $55 to even use the app. Screenshots made it seem exactly what I was looking for, so I’m disappointed that there’s a paywall

reviews.title: APP IS NOT WORKING
reviews.text: I was very excited to find out about this program and app. I signed up for the Holiday Hustle. I received instructions to download the app and I did that. The app is not working and I cannot see any pictures or words passed the first screen. I have emailed for support and have only received automated emails in return telling me exactly what I already know and have done. I would love to use this, since it’s already paid for. However, as it stands, I just wasted a lot of money.

reviews.title: Strava Integration Stopped Working
reviews.text: I love this app, but the Strava integration recently stopped working. All of my workouts show in the app, but will not successfully upload. I’m having to manually enter all my workouts and it’s such a pain. Please help!

reviews.title: Great way to stay motivated and fight hunger
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for almost a year now participating in each seasonal challenge. I’m a daily dog walker and would do so even without the app or challenge. But it doesn’t hurt to get a 5K thrown in every now and then or just the extra motivation that setting a distance goal brings. Badges are rewarded. Some people share selfies. Just makes it more fun. I just wish it worked with Apple health or fitness so I didn’t have to do manual entries every day.

reviews.title: Five stars
reviews.text:
Run across America has helped me loose weight and improved my
Mental health. Feeds America, helps feed Ukraine. It’s is a win win!

reviews.title: Run Across America
reviews.text: Fantastic Group and App - gets and keeps you motivated to move no matter your age or size. The RAA Team keeps it interesting with a reward system (virtual badges), new doable challenges, great T-shirts, and a responsive Team in the background that takes suggestions, answers questions and updates the app. Join RAA - it won’t disappoint!

reviews.title: Motivation +
reviews.text: Run Across America is a great motivator to get out and move. The app is easy to use and the badges are fun and add some satisfaction for one’s efforts. 👍👍👍

reviews.title: Run Across America Keeps You Going
reviews.text: This is a great app to keep you going.  Great community and great fun!

reviews.title: Fun though inaccurate
reviews.text:
It’s been fun to have an overall idea of how many KMs I have run/hiked/skied over an extended period of time. 

The latest update made the distance accuracy laughable. I hit 40k crossing the street the other day.  Since I know many of the distances I often run, I just edit the distance at the end of the activity. 

I wish the app worked - even as a timer - when offline. It generally won’t load at all if you don’t have a network connection.

reviews.title: Teams malfunctioning and no IT support
reviews.text:
The teams I had joined stopped showing anyone under 11 for the leadership board. Reinstalled the app yesterday and still no improvement. Today the 2teams I had been on have disappeared.
Very disappointing ks-run

reviews.title: Great fundraiser and challenges, ok app
reviews.text: Really enjoying the fundraiser and challenges. The various activities keep you engaged, and the teams aspect is fun, even if it’s just your family. App is mostly good, but has the drawback of no FitBit integration, so FB users have to manually enter activities. Still worth the effort, though!

reviews.title: The mapping is top notch
reviews.text: I needed winter motivation. This is my second winter with RAA, and I’m back to getting in/exceeding all the KM I need each day. I don’t use the social/selfie aspects but that would be fun if your friends signed up as well. I don’t have an Apple Watch, so I love the convenience of starting “go” in the app and it maps and times beautifully. Plus a “race day” style tshirt. To me, the cost of the app and shirt equates to a 10k or half-marathon one-day event, so I feel like I’m getting a bargain.

reviews.title: Holiday Hustle
reviews.text: Kept me motivated to exercise during a busy and stressful time of year!!

reviews.title: Ok, but not my favorite
reviews.text:
I’ve used Runkeeper for a few years and then got this one to participate in the Holiday Hustle. Overall, it works, but some of the UI could be much smoother. 
I don’t like that I can’t start a run from the first screen. 
Also, changing from manual mode to having the app track it is more complicated than it should be…you have to go to a settings thing that’s in tiny text, and then that becomes the default. As someone who does both app track and manual entries, that really stinks.

reviews.title: Motivation!
reviews.text: One of the tools I rely on to keep my recent T2 Diabetes diagnosis in check. With the app, I compete against myself by setting goals and then working hard to surpass them. Run Across America has provided the motivation to put my wellness first, where ever I am. Let’s get moving!!

reviews.title: So Much Fun!
reviews.text: A great way to stay energized and inspired. A supportive community and easy to navigate app.

reviews.title: Can’t see group activity?
reviews.text: When my work and I created a team on Tuesday, we could see everyone’s activity on the team page. All of a sudden on Thursday, it says “no activities posted yet” despite there definitely being activities. Is there a setting I need to change or a glitch?

reviews.title: This app is non functional
reviews.text:
This app is not only not intuitive, it isn’t functional. 

Why were my pets deleted without warning? Why advertise on Instagram as if this is for walking your dog when the pet feature barely works and then craps out? I can’t add my dog back with the code, so will just have to create a new pet and lose the data.

I’m not willing to sit on a phone to have someone explain to me why I paid $45 for a product that doesn’t work and “troubleshoot” either. I am glad I didn’t do the full year, find a better app.

reviews.title: Garmin
reviews.text: Can you please add Garmin to options for auto feed

reviews.title: So helpful!
reviews.text: The Run Across America challenges are so motivating. I love using this app to keep me running when I’d rather sit on the couch and watch Netflix!

reviews.title: Nice for selfies, kind of overpriced
reviews.text: $45 for 2 months, then when your 2 months is up, you’re just cut off without any sort of notification email on what you achieved. I did enjoy using the app, but did not use teams or social sharing, and wasn’t a huge fan of how the app interfaces, so I won’t be buying again.

reviews.title: Great motivator
reviews.text: I have used this App for 1 year. I am 61 and who knew how motivating badges could be? 😂 Using the App has helped me to become more consistent with exercising. I created a team with family members and we create a distance goal each season. The App is very easy to use. I love seeing where I placed on the leaderboard after a race.

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: My friends and I agreed to all sign up for the fall challenge, and it has been an absolute blast! The motivation is definitely there and I love all the challenges. The shirt that came with signing up is really quality, and the tracker is pretty accurate for time/distance/location. Looking forward to signing up for the winter challenge too.

reviews.title: Walking Across America for a Great Cause
reviews.text: I have been walking 5 miles a day around my neighborhood, about 5-6 times a week, since Covid hit. Recently it’s been hard to stay motivated and when I saw the Run Across America challenge I saw my motivation! Virtual badges are fun to earn, but knowing I’m helping to feed those in need is just the motivation I craved! Give it a try!!!

reviews.title: One of my favorites
reviews.text: Easy to use, motivating, and supportive.

reviews.title: Easy to use
reviews.text: Great app.  Easy to use

reviews.title: Freezing
reviews.text: This app keeps freezing up on me!

reviews.title: A bit wonky
reviews.text:
This app is not too intuitive. It took lots of searching around to decipher how to log my
distance. The settings keep defaulting, in spite of saving my own settings. The self portrait feature has been hit or miss.
The leaderboard is great fun, we enjoy writing comments to each other on our team. Not sure why everything is in kilometers, tho.

reviews.title: Run America App
reviews.text: It’s quick and easy!

reviews.title: Needs A FAQ Page
reviews.text: The idea behind this app is great, but making it work is a different story. It’s supposed to sync with my Apple Health, and it shows up in my Apple Health settings. But no sync. Within the app and on the website, there needs to be a FAQ page with troubleshooting instructions. Noticed that another user only received help when she wrote a weak review!

reviews.title: Step tracking
reviews.text: Although difficult to find, this app does have apple health tracking capabilities. I didn’t find it until writing one weak review THEN trying to manually log my own steps for my current challenge (hence my increase in stars). I think sync options should be easier to locate when someone initially signs up for a race. Additionally, I think more step tracking options besides Apple Health stats would be an improvement.

reviews.title: Great once you figure the site out
reviews.text: I started this with the 2020 Holiday Hustle. Loved it. Since then it’s been confusing to continue with each subsequent challenge. I’ve paid for the Summer Splash, friends have started (we are a team) but my app hasn’t update.  Frustrating to say the least.

reviews.title: Mot working properly
reviews.text: Does not work properly!  Shuts down randomly on its own!  Cannot adjust activity always just sometimes.

reviews.title: Love this
reviews.text: I just finished up my second challenge using this app. I don’t enjoy running, but this has been very motivating to me to keep moving.  The one time I had to contact customer support, they were very helpful.

reviews.title: Run, run and run.....😀
reviews.text: Love to run, hoping to get to know more runner from this site. Peace🙏

reviews.title: Buggy, doesn’t track well
reviews.text: Cool way to take part in virtual races, but the app does a terrible job of tracking. Sometimes tracks less than other apps, sometimes fails to log at all. My family of four are each frequently forced to manually log our times and distances even after we walked the extra distance for the app to track the amount we were supposed to do.

reviews.title: Love this for walking!
reviews.text: I am using this as a fun way to set and keep my goals!! Love seeing how far I’ve walked! Highly recommend

reviews.title: Motivates me
reviews.text: Great application for me. I enjoy the tracking and badges.  Really helps to keep me motivated to run.

reviews.title: Lousy
reviews.text: Hard to use app

reviews.title: Nice app
reviews.text: Nice app. Easy to maneuver but I wish you could add your garmin or  watch to track your miles. Instead of a manual entry.

reviews.title: UI needs work.
reviews.text:
I’ve missed out on a couple of badges because the app doesn’t make it clear how they work. The first time I did the distance but didn’t realize that awarding the badge wasn’t automatic—you have to tap the button for the special event. The second time I “entered the race” but didn’t finish the distance, so no badge—and no opportunity to try again before the deadline. Boo. 
This app really isn’t designed well for those of us who log walking distance in the course of daily life, not as a dedicated workout.
And the fact that it takes multiple taps to start logging distance is annoying.

reviews.title: Neat
reviews.text: So fun and gets me to run more. But the app will time out and lose track of your run it’s insanely frustrating
